page.overview:
What is Death Star II Restoration Fund?

The Death Star II Restoration Fund was a foundation formed during or after 4 ABY to restore the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station. The fund asked people to contribute, so they would be able to revive the superweapon, and it could also be utilized as a conference center, events space, and community hub. Raise the Death Star II!, a poster made for the fund, was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.

The Death Star II Restoration Fund was mentioned in the 2022 non-canon reference book LEGO Star Wars Awesome Vehicles.
